text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
A notebook arrived for Duramente from her 
father. Inscribed within it was the 
history of her pedigree and clan.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, this notebook. It records the path 
of those who strove forward, hoping to 
bring Japanese racing to the world.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Effort, anguish, challenge, defeat... and 
hope. Even if a wish cannot come true now, 
someone will carry on those feelings, so 
that one day, that dream will be 
fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Touched by those feelings, Duramente 
spoke. She wanted to shoulder all the 
hopes and dreams connected through her 
clan and the people who love racing.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Become the best in the world, and prove 
she's the "strongest." Her eyes blazed 
with intense resolve and an unyielding 
radiance—
